# What crates/cli/tests/e2e.rs expects for this scenario. ok/fail: does
# the job run when every job before it passed, or failed. A step `if`
# shows A/B: runs while the job passes / runs after an earlier step failed.

convert: exit 0
  `node.yml` job `test`: matrix key `os` values `macos-latest`, `windows-latest` name no runner template and were dropped; hatchrun runs Linux only
validate: exit 0
event push-main (compile refs/heads/main)
  node: triggered
    job lint on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      if !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]')
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step actions/setup-node@v4
      step run: npm ci
      step run: npm run lint
    job test (20, ubuntu-latest) on ubuntu-latest after lint: ok=run fail=skip
      matrix node=20 os="ubuntu-latest"
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step actions/setup-node@v4
      step run: npm ci
      step run: npm test
    job test (22, ubuntu-latest) on ubuntu-latest after lint: ok=run fail=skip
      matrix node=22 os="ubuntu-latest"
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step actions/setup-node@v4
      step run: npm ci
      step run: npm test
    job build on ubuntu-latest after lint: ok=run fail=skip
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step actions/setup-node@v4
      step run: npm ci
      step run: npm run build
      step Keep the bundle if github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_name == 'main': ok=run/skip
    job report on ubuntu-latest after test (20, ubuntu-latest) + test (22, ubuntu-latest) + build: ok=run fail=run
      if always()
      step run: echo "test ${{ needs.test.result }}, build ${{ needs.build.result }}"
